title: EM4200 RFID Cards
description: EM4200 125 kHz RFID cards for simple read-only proximity credentials, suited to access control, attendance and low-cost LF card issuance.
summary: EM4200 cards are 125 kHz read-only RFID credentials for simple access control and attendance use cases where low cost, stable UID behavior and broad LF reader compatibility matter.
The EM4200 card is an improved model on EM4100(discontinue), its most significant feature is the longer reading ranges than the old models.
Although the EM-ID is the most simple RFID product, but is is widely deployed in the early years, it still has very wide application. EM4200 compatible with all these already deployed system.

faq.question: What are EM4200 RFID Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for low-cost read-only access cards, attendance credentials, parking permits, and simple LF proximity programs that do not need rewritable memory.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for EM4200 RFID Cards?
faq.answer: Chip: EM4200 Protocol: ISO14443 Frequency: 125 kHz Read Range: 5-10cm, depending on readers

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for EM4200 RFID Cards?
faq.answer: Material: PVC, RPVC, PET, PETG, ABS and wood, etc. Size: CR80 (85.5*54mm) or customized. Color: White. Black, green, blue, etc., can be customized.

faq.question: How can EM4200 RFID Cards be customized?
faq.answer: Printing Options: Offset Printing, Silk-screen printing, UV printing, digital printing, etc
